mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHOPPING_LIST ( USER_NO, BOARD_NO, SHOPPING_TITLE, IMAGE_URL ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{boardNo}, ( SELECT b.BOARD_TITLE FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.BOARD_DELETE = 'N' ), ( SELECT b.IMAGE_URL FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.BOARD_DELETE = 'N' ) )

INSERT INTO SHOPPING_ITEM ( SHOPPING_NO, SET_NAME, INGREDIENT_NAME, QUANTITY, UNIT, ITEM_STATUS, ITEM_ORDER ) SELECT #{_parameter}, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SET_NAME, ''), '재료'), i.INGREDIENT_NAME, i.QUANTITY, i.UNIT, 'NEED', i.INGREDIENT_NO FROM SHOPPING_LIST sl JOIN INGREDIENT_SET s ON s.BOARD_NO = sl.BOARD_NO JOIN INGREDIENT i ON i.SET_NO = s.SET_NO WHERE sl.SHOPPING_NO = #{_parameter}
mapper.select: SELECT sl.SHOPPING_NO, sl.BOARD_NO, sl.SHOPPING_TITLE, sl.IMAGE_URL, DATE_FORMAT(sl.SHOPPING_DATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS SHOPPING_DATE, COUNT(si.ITEM_NO) AS TOTAL_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN si.ITEM_STATUS IN ('BOUGHT', 'OWNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS COMPLETED_COUNT FROM SHOPPING_LIST sl LEFT JOIN SHOPPING_ITEM si ON si.SHOPPING_NO = sl.SHOPPING_NO WHERE sl.USER_NO = #{_parameter} GROUP BY sl.SHOPPING_NO, sl.BOARD_NO, sl.SHOPPING_TITLE, sl.IMAGE_URL, sl.SHOPPING_DATE ORDER BY sl.SHOPPING_DATE DESC, sl.SHOPPING_NO DESC

SELECT sl.SHOPPING_NO, sl.USER_NO, sl.BOARD_NO, sl.SHOPPING_TITLE, sl.IMAGE_URL, DATE_FORMAT(sl.SHOPPING_DATE, '%Y.%m.%d') AS SHOPPING_DATE, t.COOK_TIME, t.DIFFICULT, t.CALORY FROM SHOPPING_LIST sl JOIN BOARD b ON b.BOARD_NO = sl.BOARD_NO LEFT JOIN TAG t ON t.TYPE_NO = b.TYPE_NO WHERE sl.SHOPPING_NO = #{shoppingNo} AND sl.USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT si.ITEM_NO, si.SHOPPING_NO, si.SET_NAME, si.INGREDIENT_NAME, si.QUANTITY, si.UNIT, si.ITEM_STATUS, si.ITEM_ORDER FROM SHOPPING_ITEM si JOIN SHOPPING_LIST sl ON sl.SHOPPING_NO = si.SHOPPING_NO WHERE si.SHOPPING_NO = #{shoppingNo} AND sl.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY si.SET_NAME, si.ITEM_ORDER, si.ITEM_NO
